The playful, sweet cherry notes are beautifully softened by almond and fluffy vanilla heliotrope. It is a highly charming, innocent, and uplifting scent perfectly suited for bright spring days.
ASSAF AROGATE COMETE EDP 200ML.name: ASSAF AROGATE COMETE EDP 200ML

ASSAF AROGATE STRIKE EDP 200ML.description: Assaf Arogate Strike is a powerful woody aromatic fragrance crafted for the ambitious modern man. It opens with an energetic burst of grapefruit and pink pepper, settling into a sophisticated vetiver and cedar base. This sharp and confident scent is an excellent choice for professional settings and daily wear.
ASSAF AROGATE STRIKE EDP 200ML.name: ASSAF AROGATE STRIKE EDP 200ML

ASSAF ARROGAS BLACK ELIXER EDP 200 ML.description: Assaf Arrogas Black Elixir is an intensely rich and powerful woody spicy fragrance that commands attention. Crafted for the bold and confident man, it boasts a potent blend of dark spices, aromatic lavender, and a robust sandalwood-licorice base. This beast-mode fragrance is highly recommended for cold winter nights and formal evening events.

ASSAF ARROGAS BLACK ELIXER EDP 200 ML.name: ASSAF ARROGAS BLACK ELIXER EDP 200 ML

Crisp grapefruit and mint transition beautifully into a spicy, sophisticated heart, finally resting on a rich base of incense and sandalwood. It projects pure confidence, making it flawlessly appropriate for both boardrooms and evening events.

ASSAF ARROGATE BLUE DE ELIXER FOR MAN ED.name: ASSAF ARROGATE BLUE DE ELIXER FOR MAN EDP 100

ASSAF ARROGATE BLUE FOR MEN 200ML.description: Assaf Arrogate Blue is a versatile woody aromatic fragrance that opens with an energetic blast of grapefruit, lemon, and mint. The spicy heart of ginger and nutmeg is perfectly balanced by a deep, woody base of incense, vetiver, and cedar. Aimed at modern men seeking a reliable signature scent, it is highly suitable for both office environments and casual outings.
ASSAF ARROGATE BLUE FOR MEN 200ML.name: ASSAF ARROGATE BLUE FOR MEN 200ML

ASSAF ARROGATE BLUE MAN EDP 200ML.description: Assaf Arrogate Blue is a versatile woody aromatic fragrance that opens with an energetic blast of grapefruit, lemon, and mint. ASSAF ARROGATE BLUE MAN EDP 200ML.name: ASSAF ARROGATE BLUE MAN EDP 200ML

ASSAF ARROGATE COLD EDP 100 ML.description: Beat the heat with Assaf Arrogate Cold, an intensely frosty and invigorating fragrance designed to provide maximum refreshment. Featuring a piercing blast of icy mint, crisp aquatic notes, and clean musk, it is the ultimate revitalizer for the active, energetic individual. Highly recommended for intense gym sessions, sports, and surviving the most sweltering summer days with cool confidence.
ASSAF ARROGATE COLD EDP 100 ML.name: ASSAF ARROGATE COLD EDP 100 ML

ASSAF ARROGATE EUPHORIA 150 ML.name: ASSAF ARROGATE EUPHORIA 150 ML

It features a narcotic white floral heart of tuberose, brightened by fruity pear and anchored by dark, earthy patchouli. This striking contrast creates a highly memorable scent profile, perfect for both daytime empowerment and evening allure.
ASSAF ARROGATE GIRL EDP 200ML.name: ASSAF ARROGATE GIRL EDP 200ML

The tart freshness of litchi and rhubarb perfectly balances a lush, dewy heart of Turkish rose and peony. It is a radiant, compliment-getting signature scent ideal for spring and summer.

ASSAF ATTACK EDP 150ML.description: Assaf Attack is an assertive and bold woody spicy fragrance that strikes with sharp pink pepper, fresh lavender, and deeply masculine woods. Targeted at confident men, it leaves a powerful and memorable trail wherever you go. Wear this commanding scent as an evening signature to project absolute strength.
ASSAF ATTACK EDP 150ML.name: ASSAF ATTACK EDP 150ML

This pristine, inoffensive, and beautiful perfume is the perfect daily signature for the office and casual wear.
ASSAF AURA EDP 150ML.name: ASSAF AURA EDP 150ML

ASSAF BAKHUR COLLECTION SET.description: The Assaf Bakhur Collection features an array of ultra-premium incense blends that celebrate the rich, deeply traditional heritage of Arabian perfumery. It is the absolute highest standard for welcoming guests and fragrancing your home during holidays.
ASSAF BAKHUR COLLECTION SET.name: ASSAF BAKHUR COLLECTION SET

Make an uncompromising, immensely powerful statement during cold winter nights with this highly potent elixir.
ASSAF WILD COLT BAKHUR 150 ML.name: ASSAF WILD COLT BAKHUR 150 ML

ASSAF WILD COLT TABACCO EDP 100 ML.description: Assaf Wild Colt Tabacco is an intensely rich, unapologetically bold fragrance that perfectly captures the sweet, dark essence of pipe tobacco and vanilla. ASSAF WILD COLT TABACCO EDP 100 ML.imageName: ASSAF WILD COLT TABACCO EDP 100 ML.jpg
ASSAF WILD COLT TABACCO EDP 100 ML.name: ASSAF WILD COLT TABACCO EDP 100 ML

ATELIER COLOGNE VANILLE INSENCSEE EDP 10.name: ATELIER COLOGNE VANILLE INSENCSEE EDP 100 ML

Ideal for the modern individual seeking a signature daytime scent, its vibrant blend of bergamot and mandarin transitions seamlessly into a floral heart of jasmine. Elevate your everyday style with this versatile and long-lasting perfume designed for casual sophistication.
DAVID WALTER 3 X 100 ML.name: DAVID WALTER 3 X 100 ML

DAVID WALTER CASUAL EDP 100ML.description: David Walter Casual is a versatile aromatic fougere fragrance that effortlessly balances crisp freshness with a warm, comforting dry down. Bursting with green apple and mint before settling into a smooth vanilla and tonka base, it is the perfect everyday reach for the modern man. Enhance your laid-back, casual style with this highly crowd-pleasing and reliable scent.
DAVID WALTER CASUAL EDP 100ML.name: DAVID WALTER CASUAL EDP 100ML

DAVID WALTER CHEERFUL 100 ML.description: David Walter Cheerful is a bright, optimistic floral fruity fragrance designed to instantly lift your mood. It opens with a crisp, refreshing splash of citrus and juicy apple. A soft, romantic floral heart of rose provides a delicate femininity, while a gentle base of vanilla and musk adds lasting comfort. This accessible, joyful scent is perfect for casual daily wear and laid-back weekends.
DAVID WALTER CHEERFUL 100 ML.name: DAVID WALTER CHEERFUL 100 ML

DAVID WALTER CRUISE EDP 100ML.description: Set sail with Samam David Walter Cruise, an invigorating, breezy aquatic fragrance that perfectly captures the spirit of an ocean voyage. Harmonizing sparkling, salty marine notes with aromatic rosemary and a deeply masculine incense and patchouli base, it is designed for the adventurous man. Highly versatile and projecting, it is the perfect companion for summer holidays, boat trips, and conquering the heat with style.
DAVID WALTER CRUISE EDP 100ML.name: DAVID WALTER CRUISE EDP 100ML

DAVID WALTER DESERT ROSE EDP 100 ML.description: David Walter Desert Rose is a deeply exotic and luxurious amber floral fragrance that captivates with a spicy saffron and black pepper opening. The heart showcases a dark, velvety Turkish rose intertwined with patchouli, resting on a magnificent base of oud and amber. This intense and seductive scent is perfect for those who want to stand out at formal winter evening events.

DAVID WALTER DESERT ROSE EDP 100 ML.name: DAVID WALTER DESERT ROSE EDP 100 ML

DAVID WALTER FACE 2 FACE 100ML.description: David Walter Face 2 Face by Samam is an exhilarating woody spicy fragrance designed for the dynamic individual. Blending fresh citrus with a warm musky base, it delivers an everyday versatile charm. It is an excellent signature scent suitable for both office and casual wear.
DAVID WALTER FACE 2 FACE 100ML.name: DAVID WALTER FACE 2 FACE 100ML

DAVID WALTER IM PRINCE LE PARFUM 100ML.description: Samam David Walter I'm Prince Le is a confident and dynamic woody spicy fragrance that exudes modern masculinity. Blending fresh apple, crisp bergamot, and warm aromatic woods, it caters to ambitious men who want to stand out with a sophisticated aura. With its versatile and well-rounded profile, it transitions seamlessly from daytime business meetings to evening social gatherings.

DAVID WALTER IM PRINCE LE PARFUM 100ML.name: DAVID WALTER IM PRINCE LE PARFUM 100ML

DAVID WALTER PIVOTAL EDP 100ML.description: Samam David Walter Pivotal is a versatile and contemporary woody floral musk fragrance designed to make a clean, professional impression. Blending bright citrus, soft floral undertones, and a solid musky base, it targets modern individuals seeking an easy-to-wear daily fragrance. Highly balanced and unobtrusive, it is an excellent choice for office environments and everyday casual wear.
DAVID WALTER PIVOTAL EDP 100ML.name: DAVID WALTER PIVOTAL EDP 100ML

DAVID WALTER SELF PORTRAIT EDP 100 ML.description: BLANK DAVID WALTER SELF PORTRAIT is a masterfully crafted fragrance that captivates from the first spritz with its vibrant top notes. The heart reveals a sophisticated blend of florals, seamlessly transitioning into a warm and enduring base. Perfect for the discerning wearer, this scent leaves a memorable trail that is both elegant and timeless, making it an essential addition to any collection.

The heart reveals a lush bouquet of rose and jasmine, settling into a rich base of vanilla and amber. Designed for the elegant individual, this scent is perfect for evening wear and special occasions where leaving a lasting impression is desired.

DAVID WALTER VIOLIN ELIXIR DE PARFUM 100.name: DAVID WALTER VIOLIN ELIXIR DE PARFUM 100ML

Anchored by a warm base of musk, vanilla, sandalwood, this scent is ideal for everyday wear, spring/summer and offers an unforgettable olfactory experience for the modern enthusiast.

DAVID WALTER VITO ELIXIR GREEN EDP 100ML.name: DAVID WALTER VITO ELIXIR GREEN EDP 100ML

This heavy and uncompromising scent is crafted for the confident man who desires a highly potent and luxurious winter signature.
DAVID WALTER VITO ELIXIR OUD 75ML.name: DAVID WALTER VITO ELIXIR OUD 75ML

Brilliantly juxtaposing fresh, breezy marine notes with candied violet, juicy raspberry, and a soft vanilla base, it is designed for the whimsical, modern romantic. DUCCI GIARDINI DI TOSCANA ALMAFOLIA EDP.description: Giardini di Toscana Almafolia is an intoxicating, opulent, and creamy white floral explosion. It is entirely centered around a massive, sweet, and buttery tuberose note, brightened initially by sweet orange and peach. A tropical, rich heart featuring coconut and ylang-ylang settles into a deeply luscious, sweet base of vanilla and amber. It is an absolute showstopper for tuberose lovers seeking a decadent, sensual, and highly projecting signature.

DUCCI GIARDINI DI TOSCANA ALMAFOLIA EDP.name: DUCCI GIARDINI DI TOSCANA ALMAFOLIA EDP 100ML

This highly meditative and luxurious scent is perfect for connoisseurs seeking a deeply complex and moving olfactory experience.

DUCCI GIARDINI DI TOSCANA COLONIA NOBILE.description: Colonia Nobile by Giardini Di Toscana is a refreshing citrus aromatic fragrance that perfectly embodies classic Italian elegance. Zesty notes of bergamot and lemon blend seamlessly with neroli and a robust oakmoss base, creating a timeless scent for the refined individual. Elevate your summer daytime wardrobe with this invigorating, artisan-crafted cologne.

DUCCI GIARDINI DI TOSCANA ROSSO RADICE E.description: Giardini di Toscana Rosso Radice is an avant-garde woody musky fragrance that beautifully blends earthy depth with molecular modernity. It begins with a bright, spicy touch of bergamot and pink pepper. The core is heavily structured around the warm, projecting molecules of ambroxan and cashmeran, supported by a classic, rooty base of vetiver and oakmoss. It is a striking, long-lasting niche choice for those who love contemporary, woody signature scents.

The heart unfolds into a lush garden of rose and peony, perfectly capturing the essence of Italian spring. A comforting base of vanilla and white musk makes this a delightful, uplifting scent for daily wear.

The exceptionally rich base of oakmoss and vanilla ensures a remarkably potent and universally loved signature scent.
